response: لا، لا يجوز الاتفاق على أن يتم التقادم في مدة تختلف عن المدة التي حددها القانون [المادة 388].

user_input: هو لو واحد رهنلي حاجة وطلع مش ملكه، حقي بيضيع ولا بفضله مضمون؟
response: إذا كان الراهن غير مالك للعقار المرهون، فإن عقد الرهن يصبح صحيحاً إذا أقره المالك الحقيقي بورقة رسمية، وإذا لم يصدر هذا القرار فإن حق الرهن لا يترتب على العقار إلا من الوقت الذي يصبح فيه هذا العقار مملوكاً للراهن [المادة 1033]. ويقع باطلا رهن المال المستقبل [المادة 1033].

user_input: Can I take back a gift I already gave someone?
response: Yes, a donor may revoke a gift if the donee consents [Article 500]. If the donee does not consent, the donor may apply to the court for authority to revoke the gift whenever they have reasonable grounds in support and when there is no obstacle to the revocation [Article 500].

user_input: Can someone who guarantees a loan be sued or have their property seized before the actual borrower?
response:
Generally, a creditor does not have the right to take proceedings against the surety alone unless he has first taken proceedings against the debtor, and can only levy execution on the property of the surety after he has distrained all the property of the debtor, provided the surety claims this right [Article 788]. 

However, a surety who has jointly and severally guaranteed the debtor cannot demand that the debtor's property first be distrained [Article 793].

user_input: Can workers or sub-contractors sue the property owner directly if they are not paid by the main contractor?
response: Yes, sub-contractors and workers who work for the contractor in executing the work have the right to sue the property owner directly for an amount not exceeding what the property owner owes to the main contractor at the time the lawsuit is filed [Article 662].

user_input: How long do I have to cancel an agreement if I made a mistake or was pressured into it?
response:
The right to invalidate a contract for mistake or duress lapses if it is not invoked by its owner within three years [Article 140 (1)]. 

In the case of a mistake, this period starts from the day it is discovered, and in the case of duress, from the day it ceases [Article 140 (2)]. In any case, it is not permissible to invoke the right to invalidate for mistake or duress if fifteen years have elapsed from the time the contract was perfected [Article 140 (2)].

user_input: Who is legally allowed to rent out wakf property?
response:
Based on the provided articles, the following persons are allowed to let (lease) wakf property:

1. **A Nazir**: A Nazir has the right to let wakf property [Article 628].
2. **A beneficiary**: A beneficiary, even if he is the sole beneficiary, can grant a lease *only if* the right to do so has been given to him by the constituent of the wakf, or *unless* he is authorized to do so by a person who has power to grant a lease, such as the Nazir or the judge [Article 628].

user_input: What happens to a partnership after its set time expires or its project is finished, if the partners just keep working?
response: If, notwithstanding the expiration of the term or the achievement of the object for which the partnership was formed, the partners continue to carry on work of the same nature as that for which the partnership was formed, the partnership's deed is extended from year to year on the same conditions [Article 526]. A creditor of a partner may oppose this extension, and his opposition will suspend the effect of the extension of the partnership so far as such creditor is concerned [Article 526].

user_input: How are partnership assets divided if the partnership agreement does not specify a method for it?
response:
When the partnership deed is silent on the manner of liquidation and partition, the liquidation and partition of the partnership property are carried out according to the following provisions:

1. The partnership assets are divided between all partners after:
   - Payment of creditors [Article 536].
   - Deduction of amounts required to cover debts that have not fallen due or are subject to litigation [Article 536].
   - Repayment of disbursements or loans that may have been made by one of the partners for the benefit of the partnership [Article 536].

2. Each partner shall take a sum equal to the value of his contribution to the capital of the partnership, as recorded in the partnership deed, or, if not recorded in the partnership deed, at its value at the time the contribution was brought to the partnership (unless he has only contributed his services, the usufruct, or the mere use of the thing brought to the partnership) [Article 536].

3. The balance, if any, will be distributed between the partners proportionally to each partner's share in the profits [Article 536].

4. If the partnership assets are not sufficient to cover the repayment of the partners' contributions, the loss is shared between the partners proportionally to each partner's share in the losses [Article 536].

user_input: How long does a person have to file a lawsuit for compensation after suffering harm from a wrongful act?
response: A claim for compensation arising from a wrongful act is prescribed by the lapse of three years from the day on which the injured party became aware of the occurrence of the harm and the person responsible for it, and in any event, it is prescribed by the lapse of fifteen years from the day the wrongful act occurred [Article 172]. However, if the claim arises from a crime and the criminal action has not yet been prescribed after the expiration of the aforementioned periods, the compensation claim shall only be prescribed when the criminal action is prescribed [Article 172].

user_input: If there are multiple joint creditors, can the debtor pay just one of them?
response: Yes, when there is solidarity between creditors, the debtor may pay the debt to any one of them unless one of them objects to such payment [Article 280].
